properties.name: Central & Western
properties.description: Dense historic district on Hong Kong Island with steep terrain, narrow streets and limited park space. Simulated district used for citizen cool-route and heat-map demonstrations.

properties.name: Yau Tsim Mong (Kowloon)
properties.description: Extremely dense Kowloon urban core. Simulated district used for street-canyon heat demonstrations.

properties.name: Northern Metropolis (Conceptual District)
properties.description: A CONCEPTUAL / SIMULATED new-district scenario inspired by the Northern Metropolis development area. This is NOT an official plan, NOT a prediction about the real Northern Metropolis, and all values are simulated for demonstration of planning-stage heat assessment.
